sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Project name
sections.what: Sets only the project name used by the Vercel hosting service. It does not change the build or the routes.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the name itself.
sections.watch_out: Renaming it here may also need a matching change in the hosting dashboard.

summary: A minimal hosting file that gives the Vercel project a name.
purpose: Name the project on the hosting service.
why: Reason not stated in the code.
how: The hosting service reads the name when the project is deployed.
outputs: A project name shown on the hosting dashboard.
risks: Very low. It sets no build steps, environment values or routes.
debug: If a deploy goes to the wrong project, check the name here and in the hosting dashboard.
